title: New affordable Casio retro LF-40W digital watches unveiled in the US
summary: Casio's LF-40W is now on sale in the US in black, blue and beige for $42.95 each. The retro digital watch has a gadget-style display with bar-shaped seconds counters and a status row. It costs about 70% more than in Japan, where it sells for ¥4,400.

title: Grab Keychron's full-sized low-profile K5 V2 wireless mechanical keyboard for its lowest-ever price of just $56
summary: If you're after a full-sized mechanical keyboard on a budget, this is one of the best deals around during early Black Friday. It has a white backlight and supports either Bluteooth or wired connectivity.

title: 上汽 MG4 增推 530 从容版：限时补贴价 7.88 万元起，纯电续航 530km
summary: IT之家 11 月 23 日消息，上汽 MG4 新增 530 从容版车型，官方指导价 8.18 万元，限时补贴价 7.88 万元。作为参考，目前 MG4 系列共有 13 款车型在售，限时补贴价 6.58 万元起。 新车定位紧凑型两厢纯电车，车身长宽高分别为 4395×1842×1551mm，轴距为 2750mm。外观采用家族化设计，前脸配备封闭式格栅和狭长大灯，下方设有蜂窝状下格栅。车身侧面采用短悬设计，搭配双色多辐轮毂，充电口位于前翼子板处；车尾配备小型扰流板，尾灯向两侧延伸，后包围加入黑色饰板。 车身颜色方面，新车提供月光白、星野灰、清波翠、东来紫、冰晶蓝、杏仁米共 6 种选择。内饰提供蔷
